title: RTP Looper (RTPL)
description: This mod perpetually repeats the command /betterrtp world world (or world_nether or world_the_end). It was made for KingSMP Network Servers, where there was a competition to find the hidden pyramid. Results are scanned and sent to a Discord webhook.
